Trump's Iran remarks draw backlash over potential California attack

US President Donald Trump suggested that Iran could "take out" Los Angeles or San Diego, a remark that drew significant backlash from Californians and late-night host Jimmy Kimmel. Kimmel stated he would report Trump to the FCC for the comment. California Governor Gavin Newsom called Trump "mentally ill" and urged his removal from office. Nuclear proliferation watchers, however, stated that Iran does not possess the capability to strike California. One report suggested Trump is gaining leverage over Iran, but questioned its ultimate significance.
